P2 ground bedroom: no lamp placed. The runParts lock refuses any lantern in this room's interior air, which shell-west owns, so the designer's lantern can't go in. The room already measures OK (0 dark cells, min 7, one dim cell at 38,2,20).
make.sh builds a whole build.nbt with the room as it stands, but the bed is still missing and the lamp is unplaced.
The designer's barrel and the y5 ceiling over z19..20 do not exist, so no hanging lantern is possible.
left: No lamp in P2 ground bedroom. A standing lantern at (36,2,20) on the y1 floor is the only spot the measurement wants, but runParts refuses it: shell-west stores interior air, which the lock counts as owned. Needs the lock to let room parts write air inside their own box (a shell/runParts decision, not a lamp fix).

The bed never gets placed. bedSet at (37,2,20) facing north checks the head's wall cell (37,2,18); that cell is air because the z18 partition is an open doorway (the walk map shows DDDD there). bedSet returns refused without a runParts report, so the room part logs 0 placed, 0 refused. The room designer needs a solid head wall or another bed position.

The designer's premise is wrong: the barrel dresser and standing lantern on the barrel lid were never placed (the NW corner is shell-owned air), and the y5 layer over z19..20 is air (the upper floor covers z14..18 only). A hanging lantern has no block to hang from until the roof is built, and the roof part is still skipped (no roof.json).

Light: the bedroom gets its light from the neighbouring hearth through the open partition and glass windows. The tool's block-light model counts glass as clear and ignores sky light, so the readings hold with or without the ceiling. One floor cell (38,2,20) sits at level 7, so it is not yet 8+ without a lamp.
